name: Black Drake's Heart
summary: In Lethlor Ravine, a black drake's heart carries the heat Sigrun Ironhew needs for his fiery weapon enchantments. He asks you to bring one from the ravine's drakes.

sections.title: A Smith's Request
sections.body: Sigrun Ironhew learned a fiery enchantment from his former teacher, Feranor Steeltoe. To use the technique, he needs blood from a rare black drake whelp's still-beating heart. Bring him one from Lethlor Ravine, and he will show you the enchantment.

faq.q: What is a Black Drake's Heart for?
faq.answer: Sigrun Ironhew needs its blood to teach you a fiery weapon enchantment.
Scorched Guardians and Scalding Whelps in Lethlor Ravine can yield a Black Drake's Heart.
Sigrun Ironhew is an apprentice of Feranor Steeltoe, who taught him a special technique for imbuing weapons with fiery enchantments.
It lets weapons strike with searing heat.

angles.text: Sigrun Ironhew offers to teach you his fiery weapon enchantment if you bring him a black drake's heart from Lethlor Ravine.
